question: The doctor on call asks the blood bank for blood products for a polytraumatized patient of the A + group. If this were not available, which of the following would be the most appropriate alternative treatment?

options.opa: Concentrate of red blood cells of group AB + and plasma AB.
options.opb: Concentrate of red blood cells of group B + and plasma AB.
options.opc: Concentrate of red blood cells of group 0+ and plasma AB.
options.opd: Concentrate of red blood cells of group B + and plasma B.

analysis: In emergency situations where blood products of the same blood type are not available, the universal donor blood type O negative is the safest option to use as it can be transfused to patients of any blood type without causing a transfusion reaction.
